item.text: The strongest leads need different first checks: C24 needs an offline measurement repair, the router needs dtype and dispatch verification, and sampler fusion needs its watermark and specialization gates resolved. I’ll keep C03 and grouped C01 on hold and distinguish qualification proposals from service-ready candidates.

I’m retaining three hypotheses. DeepInfer’s host-overhead patches remain useful inspection leads, but the supplied material does not establish an equivalent local hot path. Each retained proposal will start with a CPU-only decision gate and keep future GPU costs separate from the two remaining service attempts.
